note: Five concise reviews authored against this baseline and saved with the concise release; sourceCommit identifies baseline, not the release commit.

9b6180ff-532c-4ca8-8565-62328eb30f79.headline: Big objectives. Broken base.
9b6180ff-532c-4ca8-8565-62328eb30f79.team: We secured major buffs and produced a dominant fight, but the late objective sequence ended with heavy deaths before the base losses piled up. Winning a neutral does not make the whole exchange good; that buff was no condom for the base.

focus.title: Call the exit before the take
focus.action: Before the next major objective, agree where the team retreats and who handles the base defense.

perPlayer.9ec9a569-ce18-4a46-8f58-98d28b3b75d1: Crunch kept the farm moving, but survival was a mess. Review the late death outside the main fight and find whether retreat was available. A full wallet does fuck-all from the death screen.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Narbash delivered the healing, but spent too much time dead. Keep the healing output; work out which deaths actually protected someone and which only handed over another kill. Being support isn't a license to donate his ass.
perPlayer.4adab30d-c60a-4995-a659-c46fe0768ed2: Serath was the clear damage and objective engine. Keep that pressure, and pair the next neutral setup with a safely placed ward; strong output deserves better information than the sparse ward placement here.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Howitzer had the team's worst death count despite contributing damage. Review the repeated deaths for a common decision, then change that decision first. A fashionable build is not a fucking respawn discount.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Eden combined repeated deaths with farm below the recorded baseline. Prioritize reachable waves between fights, and review the midgame death for a safer route. Recovery starts with income that does not require another death.

90a87d12-ad66-4c03-8137-3999c53e0999.headline: Too little return from the fights.
90a87d12-ad66-4c03-8137-3999c53e0999.team: The enemy won most recorded fight sequences and took towers while we took none. The deaths before Fangtooth and the later tower loss deserve more attention than chasing a different shopping list.

focus.title: Set the contest condition
focus.action: Before the next Fangtooth setup, agree what must be ready to contest and what makes the team back off.

perPlayer.9681844e-07b6-4b92-8247-00a5a393b35a: Gadget led the team in hero damage and kept farm close to the recorded baseline. Preserve that foundation; review the death before Fangtooth for a safer position or earlier retreat, while keeping the farming rhythm that held up here.
perPlayer.8cc8b136-b5f5-4d0b-be88-2a425b3927e3: Aurora's economy barely got off the floor, with no completed item. Check farm access and time actively playing before prescribing a different build; first establish where the income stopped, then fix that bottleneck.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Yin delivered the team's strongest kill and objective output. Keep the pressure, then review the death before Fangtooth for a safer approach. The productive parts of this game need preserving, not a wholesale rebuild.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock placed the most wards, but farm and survival were rough. Prioritize reachable waves between fights and review the death around the tower loss. The gun needs gold, not a fucking sympathy card.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Steel led mitigation, but vision placement was sparse. Add wards on safe objective approaches before the next setup, and judge their timing and coverage. Walking into danger just to pad the ward count fixes nothing.

16.call: The 0-3 sequence ended as an Outer Tower fell; enemy Mini Prime followed.

11.6.call: Yin and Gadget died in a 0-2 sequence before enemy Fangtooth.

8cc8b136-b5f5-4d0b-be88-2a425b3927e3.build: No completed items in the final inventory.

05ad9a23-e6d6-42ec-893d-726fdb33a84c.headline: A proper win: the squad broke the base and finished the job.
05ad9a23-e6d6-42ec-893d-726fdb33a84c.team: Major objectives stayed with the squad, and the closing fights produced a demolished enemy base. The late outer-tower loss barely interrupted the finish; this was control with an ending, not endless foreplay around the river.

focus.title: Call the finish before the chase
focus.action: After the next won fight, the shot-caller should name the safest reachable structure and check the wave and team health; if the push is unsafe, call the reset immediately.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks did excellent objective work, but ward placement was poor despite useful clearing. Next game, place a ward on a safe objective approach before committing; the jungle cannot run on good intentions and a flimsy condom of vision.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 delivered strong carry damage. The late death is the moment to review. Next game, confirm nearby peel before advancing into enemy jungle and keep a safe route back to the team.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett supplied real defense and strong warding, but no objective damage. Next game, make the post-fight job explicit: guard the approach or hit the objective, then stick to that assignment.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy's Belica delivered strong damage with few deaths and contributed to objectives. Keep that shit. Repeat the follow-through next game: add objective damage after a safe fight win once the approach is covered.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs earned the praise on Steel: strong takedown contribution without a death. Vision denial deserves the next rep. Before an objective setup, check the contested approach with a teammate and clear reachable enemy wards.

20.4.call: A 3-1 kill cluster ended at 20:55; an enemy outer tower fell eleven seconds later. The follow-through mattered.

24.7.call: Five enemy deaths, no allied deaths in this cluster. Two inner towers and two inhibitors fell from 25:07 through 25:46. That was the decisive damage to the base.

27.8.call: Four enemy deaths without an allied death in the closing cluster. The Core fell at 28:33. Finish secured.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Wukong recorded strong objective damage while equipped with Manta Scythe, Infernum, The Perforator and Painweaver. No comparison here isolates their value, and the missing-magic-resist flag alone does not establish a build mistake.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher and Imperator match the recorded comparison core. Nothing in the death event establishes that a different item would have prevented it.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Mistmeadow Buckler, Terminus and Tainted Bastion differ from the comparison core. The mitigation total supports a defensive contribution, but cannot isolate item value or prove the build caused zero objective damage.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Caustica and Noxia were equipped. The performance supports keeping this as a useful baseline, not declaring the combination optimal or attributing the win to Caustica.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Fire Blossom, Xenia, Dynamo and Prophecy accompanied a deathless support game. That result does not isolate their individual value or prove the comparison core worse.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: This review does not model Steel's Eternal contribution; no claim about its effectiveness follows from these totals.

33247683-e032-4d42-aa29-19fa4f201ce1.headline: Good win. The early duo deaths still need cleaning up.
33247683-e032-4d42-aa29-19fa4f201ce1.team: The squad took structures without losing any and secured Mini Prime despite conceding Fangtooth. The duo recovery mattered, but a win does not spray enough deodorant over the early deaths to make them disappear.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks delivered strong objective work without dying; ward placement remained thin. Next game, add a safe approach ward before starting an objective. The useful pressure should stay, and the vision habit needs to catch up.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 supplied the kills after Mini Prime, but repeated early deaths made this a mixed game. Review those deaths before changing items and pick one concrete adjustment to carry into the next match.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Greystone contributed objective damage and led ward placement without dying. Useful work that deserves credit. Keep placing approach vision before joining an objective setup, then help the team complete the take.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy's Belica led hero damage without dying, but recorded no objective damage. Next game, look for a safe objective hit after the fight; the damage needs somewhere useful to go once enemy heroes stop volunteering.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Riktor had a rough opening and cleared no wards. Make vision denial the next focus: check the objective approach alongside a teammate and clear reachable wards before the team commits.

12.9.call: Mini Prime fell before Murdock killed Phase and Zinx; an outer tower followed the kills. Kill credit does not establish who else was present.

15.3.call: This kill cluster went 1-2. No timestamped positions establish who could join, so the feed cannot justify the old claim that teammates were pinned elsewhere or the fight was a local 5v5.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Manta Scythe and Infernum were equipped. No winning-core comparison exists for Wukong; the missing-magic-resist flag does not establish a costly mistake.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Lightning Hawk and Vanquisher match the first two items in the comparison core. Purchase times are estimates, so the report cannot claim an early Vanquisher spike.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Overlord was equipped when the short match ended. Missing later comparison items is not a demonstrated mistake; no observed purchase timing establishes what could have been completed.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Combustion and Wraith Leggings were equipped. Estimated item timings cannot prove the build landed exactly on curve, and this match does not isolate a benefit from replacing either item.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Dynamo and Xenia match two comparison-core items. The inventory alone does not explain the early deaths.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Riktor's Eternal contribution is not modeled in this review; no performance verdict is assigned to it.

focus.title: Make the objective call before committing
focus.action: Before contesting the next major objective, the shot-caller should confirm who can actually join and call either the contest or a specific cross-map trade.

7f2d94e6-5d00-4927-9818-ee86d6f6349f.headline: Dominant win. The carry delivered; vision still needs work.
7f2d94e6-5d00-4927-9818-ee86d6f6349f.team: Murdock supplied the main damage while Wukong drove objective output and the squad took both recorded Fangtooths. The fighting and objective results earned the win, but the support vision contribution still needs to catch up; smashing faces is only part of the job.

focus.title: Give the objective setup a vision job
focus.action: Before the next major objective, the shot-caller should assign one teammate to clear the approach and another to cover them before the team starts it.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks delivered kills and team-leading objective damage without dying. Strong game, thin ward placement. Keep the objective pressure, but add a safe ward on the exit route before committing so the retreat has information too.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 carried the damage and kept deaths low. Strong game. Maintain that standard in the next teamfight: hit the nearest safe target and keep enough room to respond when the enemy turns.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett contributed warding but no objective damage. After the next won fight, make the assignment explicit: protect the approach or hit the objective, then give the team a clear call on which job is covered.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy's early death to Bayle is the review point. Revisit the decision leading into it and choose one concrete adjustment for the next match. Fix the decision first; the shopping list can wait.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Steel made a strong contribution to takedowns and led mitigation, but vision placement was sparse. Keep the fighting contribution; next game, place available wards on safe objective approaches and check their coverage with the team.
